messages:
maya: quick decision thread for Optimize pilot: two customers (MediPrompt latency-sensitive, SparkChat cost-sensitive). need a minimal launch slice this week covering batching, prefix cache behavior, quant fallback gating, and eval-driven alerts.
jorge: propose three profiles: Sprint (latency), Thrift (cost), Watchtower (safety/canary). Sprint = conservative batching, aggressive prefix cache; Thrift = larger batches, int8 fallback allowed; Watchtower = eval checks + slow rollout.
kevin: acceptance sketch:
- Sprint: p95 <= 275ms on canonical short-chat workload over 1h window
- Thrift: >=20% per-token cost reduction vs baseline (24h sampling)
- Quant fallback: only auto-enable when customer's golden set shows <=1.5% composite metric drop
- Eval alerts: posts to console & slack within 4m with top 5 failing examples and runbook link
rachel: infra note: KV cache variant compatibility not implemented. fallbacks will spin new variant instances (cold cache). we should rate-limit auto-fallbacks and document warm-up token overhead. infra-bot: ticket INF-4722 created for fallback limiter.
maya: rollout plan: canary Watchtower at 5% for 48h, widen if no critical alerts. Thrift behind opt-in. assign owners: jorge (product + docs), kevin (runtime + CLI), rachel (infra + runbook).
jorge: small UX asks: preview impact for customers using their golden set and a CLI to upload/validate golden sets. kevin: will add `ri optimize preview` and `ri optimize validate-golden` commands.
maya: risks: noisy signals from tiny golden sets, cache warm-up costs, over-tuning thresholds. mitigations: recommend >=100 prompts, require sustained delta for 3m before paging, shadow multi-customer traffic pre-launch.
kevin: timeline: today finalize acceptance + one-pager, next Tue runtime PR with profiles + fallback gate, next Thu enable eval hooks and canary.
maya: decision: move forward with Sprint/Thrift/Watchtower lanes and owners as assigned. follow-up Fri 9am PT.
jorge: I'll draft the one-pager and the templated golden set.
maya: thanks all. end.
